**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

Section 11.6 of the Agreement already contains a workable mutual insurance regime, so this "missing"-kind rule is satisfied:

- **11.6 (chapeau)** — primary coverage, A.M. Best "A-VII" or better carriers, AbbVie named as additional insured on the GL policy.
- **11.6.1** — workers' compensation at statutory limits, employer's liability, and general liability (per-occurrence plus aggregate) expressly including Clinical Trial Insurance.
- **11.6.2** — certificates of insurance on request, plus tail coverage where only claims-made forms are available.
- **11.6.3** — preserves AbbVie's right to self-insure, which benefits us and should be left untouched.

Two sub-elements short of the preferred wording were noted in the rationale rather than flagged:

1. The limits in 11.6.1(b)–(c) and the tail period in 11.6.2 are redacted (`[***]`), so quantum should be confirmed against the disclosure schedules.
2. No separate E&O or cyber/privacy line. This is not material here — the deal is a development and option collaboration for licensed compounds, not a services/hosting engagement where Harpoon processes our personal data or works on our premises, so the walk-away trigger is not engaged and clinical-trial GL is the risk-appropriate cover.

On that basis the clause meets the rule's material terms and was not redlined.
